title: Why Carbs Destroy Your Productivity
hook: A ton of carbs for breakfast or lunch will lower your productivity.
body: A heavy breakfast makes your body spend energy digesting, which gives you that food coma, lethargic feeling. If you're just drinking black coffee, your energy is higher. You can keep that productivity all day if you do what I do and eat a salad or a very low carb meal for lunch. Nobody is grinding out insane productive 12 hour days eating donuts and pizza.
close: Leave a comment to let me know what you usually eat for lunch on a work day.
